target_customer: Small and mid-sized finance teams and solo CFOs who run budgeting and FP&A
problem: Finance teams build budgets in disconnected spreadsheets and tools. Cashboard aims to let one person run planning with software and AI doing repetitive work.

founders.name: Julian Rowlands
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he raised 124M USD from investors including Accel, Bessemer, Kleiner and YC without naming the company; Xendit role comes from an Axios Pro summary.

competitors.name: Cube
competitors.traction_then: 400 percent ARR growth cited in June 2022 coverage
competitors.funding_then: 30M USD Series B led by Battery Ventures, June 2022

competitors.name: Mosaic
competitors.funding_then: 25M USD Series B in April 2022, 46M USD total

competitors.name: Abacum
competitors.funding_then: Series A in 2022 reported at 25M USD led by Atomico (another source says 30M USD Benchmark)

technical_complexity.rationale: Data integrations with accounting and payroll systems, collaborative budgeting UX and later a semantic layer for AI; standard SaaS with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Budget data and workflows lock in finance teams, but better-funded FP&A vendors already existed at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; incumbents kept selling and AI assistants later became a new competing layer.

market_need_then: FP&A startups raised large rounds in 2022 (Cube, Mosaic, Abacum), showing demand for modern planning tools among mid-market finance teams.

branding.domain_note: Uses cashboard.co per YC page and company site; exact .com not confirmed

identity.voice_and_tone: Product-led positioning around the 'solo CFO' idea

branding.community_and_virality: Podcast appearances by the founder (Slice of Finance, What Worked); no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: The compound name is easy to say but generic and close to other 'cash' and 'board' names. The 'solo CFO' tagline is the more memorable asset.

pivots.to: AI-native FP&A and semantic layer between financial data and AI assistants
pivots.why: Positioning moved to AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) per company site and Axios 2026 coverage; date not stated

outcome_analysis: Cashboard raised a 1.5M USD pre-seed around YC in 2022, then stayed lean for four years before a 5M USD seed led by FINTOP in July 2026 as it repositioned toward AI-assisted FP&A. The slow capital path suggests modest early traction with a later AI-driven reacceleration, but revenue is not public. Still active at six people.
notes: Pre-seed: YC page says announced July 19, 2022; Startupintros dates it 5 July 2022 and names TTV Capital as lead; recorded as 2022-07. Seed was stated by the company site, Lowenstein and Axios search snippets (Axios page itself returned 403). Total funding is reported as 5.13M, 6.9M USD by different aggregators. Seedtable names a different founder (Ashwin Balamohan); not recorded because no company source confirms it. Founded year 2021 per YC page; a source says Spring 2022.
